rationale: Shift the int8 keep-float budget inside the winning recurrent tail from Q/K-heavy rescue to K/V-heavy rescue, while retaining only the final block Q in fp16. This is a compact export-budget change aimed directly at the final int8+zlib roundtrip metric, testing whether tail value-path preservation helps more than earlier tail query preservation without adding training-time cost.
title: Recurrent Tail V/K Float Reallocation
